name: Humboldt Research Fellowship for Postdocs
other_rules: Doctorate within the last 4 years (or completed before the selection meeting)
not a German national (unless abroad more than 10 years)
no more than 90 days in Germany in the 18 months before applying
two expert reviews, one from the doctoral supervisor
notes: Three calls a year opening 15 Mar, 15 Jul and 15 Nov, each closing early once 800 applications arrive; selection meetings in Nov, Mar and Jul. The current call is full; the next opens 15 Nov 2026 (no fixed deadline, so final_deadline is blank). 6-24 months in up to three stays within three years. Host uploads a mentoring agreement and statement. Approval rate about 20-25%.

documents.name: List of key publications
